name: BoltzGen and Fold-CP
label: starting-point
notes: boltzgen.def installs a PyTorch nightly, which upstream withdraws after a while; pin a release if that step fails. fold-cp.sif and boltzgen-ligand-parser.sif are built on top of boltzgen.sif. The ligand-parser definition checks the hash of the file it patches and stops if your BoltzGen build differs. Not yet built from clean by us: expect to fix things.

fetch.instructions: Download the BoltzGen artifacts from the upstream Hugging Face repositories listed in the BoltzGen README into <weights>/boltzgen: boltzgen1_diverse.ckpt, boltzgen1_adherence.ckpt, boltzgen1_ifold.ckpt, boltz2_conf_final.ckpt, boltz2_aff.ckpt and mols.zip.
